# Teachers.Net

> Teachers.Net is a comprehensive education network providing lesson plans, teaching jobs, live chat communities, and classroom resources for K-12 educators.

Teachers.Net serves as a central hub for teacher collaboration, professional development, and resource sharing across all grade levels and subject areas. The platform features 200+ active chatboards, 3000+ lesson plans, and real-time job listings, making it one of the largest teacher communities online.

## Key Topics

- Lesson Plans
- Teaching Jobs
- Teacher Chatboards
- Grade Levels
- Subject Areas
- Classroom Projects
- Teacher Community
- Professional Peer Groups
- Education Resources
- Job Listings
- Special Education
- Technology in Education
- Teacher Networking
- Curriculum Resources
- Discussion Forums

## Core Community & Chat

- [Teachers.Net Chat Center](https://teachers.net/chat): 24-hour live teacher chat center with subject and grade-level specific chatboards
- [Teacher Chatboards](https://teachers.net/mentors): 200+ active teacher chatboards organized by grade level and subject area
- [Live Teacher Chat Rooms](https://teachers.net/chatrooms): Live chat rooms for real-time teacher discussions and peer networking
- [General Teachers Chatboard](https://teachers.net/chatboard): General teacher chatboard for discussions on resources, jobs, and lesson plans
- [Professional Peer Groups](https://teachers.net/peers): Professional peer groups for teacher networking and collaborative discussions

## Lesson Plans & Curriculum

- [Free Lesson Plans](https://teachers.net/lessons): 3000+ free lesson plans and curriculum resources searchable by grade and subject
- [Grade Level Resources](https://teachers.net/grades): Grade-level organized resources: preschool through high school with chatboards
- [Subject Area Resources](https://teachers.net/subjects): Subject-specific resources: math, science, language arts, special education, more
- [Language Arts Center](https://teachers.net/english): Language Arts Center with reading, writing, literature lessons and resources
- [Classroom Projects](https://teachers.net/projects): Collaborative classroom projects including pen pals, Flat Stanley, and field trips

## Teaching Jobs & Employment

- [Teaching Job Listings](https://teachers.net/jobs): Searchable teaching job listings across charter schools, public schools, and districts

## Specialized Resources

- [State Teacher Resources](https://teachers.net/states): State-by-state teacher networks with local jobs, lesson plans, and chatboards
- [Teacher Technology Center](https://teachers.net/tech): Technology resources: computer teachers, internet safety, Apple classroom, software
- [Teaching Methods & Theory](https://teachers.net/method): Discussions on teaching methods, educational theory, and classroom management
- [Hot Topics](https://teachers.net/hot-topics): Current trending topics: tech, classroom websites, educational software, blogs

## Homepage

- [Teachers.Net Homepage](https://teachers.net): Teachers.Net homepage: central hub for lesson plans, jobs, chat, and education resources

## Optional

- [Teacher Advertising](https://teachers.net/advertising): Advertising and sponsorship opportunities on Teachers.Net platform
